title: Deductible Card — Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts
content:
**Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts deductibles.** The holder chooses one deductible at sale from the amounts the coverage level offers. The coverage level sets how often that deductible is taken and whether it disappears at the selling store.

| Coverage level | Deductibles offered at sale (USD) | Deductible taken | No deductible when repaired at the selling store |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Shield Powertrain | 100, 250 | once per component group repaired | no |
| Kessler Shield Powertrain Plus | 100, 250 | once per component group repaired | no |
| Kessler Shield Select | 0, 100, 250 | once per repair visit | yes |
| Kessler Shield Preferred | 0, 100, 250 | once per repair visit | yes |
| Kessler Shield Exclusionary | 0, 100, 250 | once per repair visit | yes |
| Kessler Shield Exclusionary Wrap | 0, 100 | once per repair visit | yes |

**Once per repair visit** means that one repair order bears the deductible once, however many component groups it repairs. **Once per component group repaired** means that each component group repaired on the repair order bears it.

**Disappearing deductible.** At the levels marked yes, no deductible is taken when the covered repair is done at the store that sold the contract.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** Take a repair order at a store other than the selling store that repairs two component groups, with a deductible chosen at sale of 100:
- at a level that takes the deductible once per repair visit, 100 is taken once for the visit;
- at a level that takes it once per component group repaired, 100 is taken for each group, 200 in all.
